calculationPolicy: Membership only. Recalculate event counts, severity, open backlog, exposure, recurrence and priority signals from the currently filtered event set in JavaScript.

group.issueDetail: A case was closed before required evidence was attached. Quality assurance reopened the case and completed the missing review.
A corporate action instruction was not reflected in the processing platform before the deadline. The operations team completed a manual correction and confirmed the position.
A fee parameter was applied to an ineligible account population. The variance was identified through a billing quality review.
A payment request contained a mismatch between the approved instruction and the processing record. The payment was paused and corrected before final settlement.
A product mapping was linked to the wrong processing rule. Several records were routed to an incorrect downstream queue.
A reconciliation difference remained open because ownership was not assigned promptly. The break was escalated after exceeding the team threshold.
A request remained in an unmonitored queue after transfer between teams. The receiving team completed the request after escalation.
A required account attribute was entered with an outdated value during setup. Downstream processing used the incorrect attribute until an exception was raised.
A restriction was recorded in one system but not synchronized to the execution platform. The discrepancy was detected during a post-trade control.
A scheduled batch completed after the expected processing window because capacity thresholds were exceeded. Dependent reports and downstream files were delayed.
A subset of statements was not delivered because an output file failed validation. The file was regenerated and delivery was completed.
A third-party file changed structure without a coordinated production update. Records were rejected until the parser was adjusted.
A time-sensitive client notification was not generated after a workflow status changed. The service team identified the missing message during a follow-up review.
A transaction was posted twice after a retry was processed as a new request. The duplicate was detected during daily reconciliation and reversed.
An employee entitlement remained active after a role change. A periodic access review identified the unnecessary permission.
